desc: Analyze problem: lcm(a,b)=m<=T iff both a,b divide m<=T; values > T are isolated.
Choose efficient approach: streaming last-divisor per multiple with DSU over present values <= T.
Implement `countComponents`: split big vs small, build DSU with value->index mapping, union via last[m] over multiples, count distinct roots, add big count.
Verify examples (4 and 2), threshold=1, all-values>threshold, and chain cases through shared multiples.
Confirm performance bounds ~O(T log T) for T up to 2e5 and memory feasible.
